subject.title: Bound batch file read with size cap in config-set-input

question: Should `openclaw config set --batch-file` adopt this exact 8 MiB hard limit for existing user batch files?
rationale: The mechanism mitigates an unbounded-read availability risk, but the specific fixed cutoff is a new user-visible compatibility boundary and the related hook-metadata limit does not establish the batch-input contract.

options.title: Adopt 8 MiB with proof
options.body: Keep the proposed cap after adding boundary coverage and terminal proof that normal input succeeds while an oversized batch file fails clearly.

options.title: Choose a different contract
options.body: Select and document a different batch-file limit if expected operational batch sizes make 8 MiB too restrictive.

recommendation.title: Adopt 8 MiB with proof
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed cap after adding boundary coverage and terminal proof that normal input succeeds while an oversized batch file fails clearly.
